description: ageInYears(dob 2004-02-29, 2026-02-28) is 21: Period.between(dob, d).getYears(), so the leap-day birthday has not yet completed on 28 February of a non-leap year (3.7)
ageInYears(dob 2004-02-29, 2026-03-01) is 22: one day later the leap-day birthday has completed, and the result is an Integer, not a Decimal (3.7, 3.9)
monthsBetween(2026-01-31, 2026-02-28) is 0: Period.between(a, b).toTotalMonths() counts only completed months, and 31 January to 28 February is not a completed month (3.7)
addMonths(2026-01-31, 1) is 2026-02-28: d.plusMonths(n) clamped to the end of the month, so the result is a Date and never an invalid 31 February (3.7)
